notes: Multimeter now connects to OWON HDS meters on Linux — they are raw USB devices, not serial ports, so BoardScope now talks to them over WebUSB directly (no kernel driver or setup needed; also works on Windows/macOS desktop). Handles both :READ? and :DMM:MEAS? SCPI firmware dialects and keeps the measurement mode synced. Includes all 6.0.15 fixes: desktop CONNECT serial picker, real app version in the title bar, Gemini setup on Linux, self-updating AI models, OWON auto-reconnect.
